title: CORE-7130 · service-box → FAQ gap — VERIFIED, not reproducible at any width
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7130](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7130)

**Premise not reproducible. No code written, no PR.**

`scanclone.mjs` enumerated the real universe across all 56 mapped clone pages: **22 pages** have an FAQ
section with a section directly above it. Every one measured live-vs-clone at
**1800 / 1700 / 1590 / 1440 / 1024 / 768 / 360** — 154 structural + 154 painted readings.

**Max |delta| = 0.01px, everywhere.** Not 30px, not in either direction, and not in the 1441-1799 band
(sampled at 1700).

All three possible readings of "service box" are covered and all match: ServiceAds ad tiles (12 pages,
50px), PurchaseAnAddress tiles (3 pages, 110/75/50), and the BuyServiceCard price box
(`/business-telephone`, 86.00px on both).

## Why they match, with sources

- Live `styles.0034670079b7ea5097e0.css`: `.Section--section { margin-bottom: 3.125rem }`,
  `@media(min-width:1023px){ 4.6875rem }`, `@media(min-width:1590px){ 6.875rem }` = **50 / 75 / 110**.
- Clone `SectionWrapper.styles.ts:18`: `mb-[50px] min-[1023px]:mb-[75px] min-[1590px]:mb-[110px]`.

Value-for-value and breakpoint-for-breakpoint identical.

## A blocking bug in the first pass — why this looked promising

The earlier sweep built live URLs as `pathArg + '/'`, so 9 of the 22 pages were fetched at the wrong
path and hit **404 pages** (`/basic-package/` instead of `/package/basic-package/`,
`/business-address/` instead of `/additional-services/business-address/`, `/llp/` instead of
`/compare-packages/llp/`). Those recorded `sections=1`, and the diff step then bailed on
"SECTION COUNT DIFFERS" and printed nothing — a silent hole covering exactly the package /
additional-services / compare-packages families. Re-swept correctly against a sitemap-derived map.

## CORE-7002's wrapper-padding mechanism: checked and ruled out here

Full ancestor chains recorded on 4 pages x 6 widths. On live the service-box section and the FAQ section
are siblings **inside the same** `div.Wrapper--wrapper__content`, so its `padding: 20px 0` sits outside
the pair and contributes nothing between them. The clone already mirrors that padding on `<main>`
(`min-[1023px]:pb-5`). `sameParent === true` and `prev.nextElementSibling === FAQ` on both sites at
every width.

## Latent difference logged, currently inert

Live's FAQ `<section>` is `flex/column`; the clone's is `display:block`. A future `mt-*` on the FAQ
header would collapse out on the clone but not on live. Painted gap == structural gap on both today, so
it does not bite yet.

## Disposition

Close as not-reproducible, or bounce back for a specific page + viewport + screenshot. "SHARED" is not
supportable — all 22 shared surfaces with this boundary match. Note the gap below any section is
CMS-editable per block (`sectionLayout.gap` -> `SectionWrapper`), so even a genuine single-page
discrepancy would be Payload data, not code.
acceptanceCriteria: Ticket closed as not-reproducible, or reopened with a specific page + viewport + screenshot.
If reopened, note the value is CMS data (sectionLayout.gap), not code.
Latent flex-vs-block difference on the FAQ section recorded for future reference.
